artboards.label: 1 · A · Native macOS tabs — titles only
artboards.note: A: the Mac draws the tabs — titles only. ① Titles, × and + are AppKit's. ② The project and its AI sit in the pill. ③ The account sits by the faces.

artboards.label: 2 · B · Figma-style strip — the tabs say more
artboards.note: B: Maude draws the strip, so tabs carry state. ① Square + name. ② W = a second account. ③ AI working, or ? when it needs you. Home stays first.

artboards.label: 3 · A · 20 tabs — titles shorten, » lists the rest
artboards.note: A at 20 tabs: titles shorten, » lists the rest. AI in a tab you left reaches you as a Mac notification; ⌘K lists every open tab.

artboards.label: 4 · B · 20 tabs — square and short name on every tab
artboards.note: B at 20 tabs: every tab keeps its square and name. “10 more” lists the rest with folder, account and state; a ring marks a resting tab.

artboards.label: 5 · A or B — the trade-offs, and a pick
artboards.note: Proposed: A now; one spark on the tab later, if it's missed. B's richer strip costs a reversed plan decision and the Mac's window tools. Picking A amends CONTRACT §6 (tab avatar, tab menu).

artboards.label: 6 · Right-click a tab — whose menu it is
artboards.note: One right-click, two owners. If A wins, Sign in as another account… moves to the account chip and Rename… to Home (CONTRACT §6).

artboards.label: 7 · A · Tabs and windows — drag out, merge back, open once
artboards.note: Proposed: a project opens once. Opening it again — from Home, ⌘K or a link — switches to its tab, in whichever window holds it.

artboards.label: 8 · A · Two accounts on this Mac — the account is the project's
artboards.note: The account belongs to the project, on this Mac. It sits by the faces. Signing out signs out every project on that account.

artboards.label: 9 · Home, scrolled — everything you touched
artboards.note: Home answers “where was I?” before you search. Scrolled, Ask AI and Start with an empty canvas ⌘N stay on top; projects group by account. Shared with you lists only canvases from other people's projects.

artboards.label: 10 · ⌘K on Home — before you type
artboards.note: An empty Search is a shortcut list. Recent searches, open tabs with their AI, recent canvases — from every project, open or not.

artboards.label: 11 · Pinned on top, sorted your way
artboards.note: Pinned on top, then the tree, sorted your way. Hover a row for its pin and ⋯. Recent is a sort here — the same order 01's Recent list shows.

artboards.label: 12 · Drag into a folder · rename in place
artboards.note: Drag onto a folder; double-click to rename. ① The folder says where it lands. ② ↵ renames, esc keeps the name. Or Menu › File › Move to…

artboards.label: 13 · Move to trash, Restore, clear out
artboards.note: Nothing is gone until you clear out the trash. ① Move to trash ② Undo ③ Trash: the panel's last row, also in Canvases › Advanced ④ Clear out asks — and only an owner clears out the trash.

artboards.label: 14 · 21 artboards — jump from the panel
artboards.note: A canvas row opens into its artboards — the jump list. Click one of the 21 and the canvas glides there. Layers lists what's inside one.

artboards.label: 15 · ⌘K — every project, grouped
artboards.note: From 2+ projects, results group by project — this tab first. Another tab switches to it; a closed project opens a tab.

artboards.label: 16 · Artboards by name, accents and typos
artboards.note: Every word counts, in any order. “letak a6 predni” finds LetakA6 › A · přední FLAG. One letter off still finds Uniformy-2027 — and says so.

artboards.label: 17 · Versions with pictures — looking at yesterday
artboards.note: Click a version to look at it, read-only. Each has its picture and a face or the spark. Restore this version adds it as a new version — Now stays.

artboards.label: 18 · Compare two versions — every change, and what Restore takes back
artboards.note: A and B side by side; every change, in words. Restore this version brings back the whole canvas (git: 06 › 10).

artboards.label: 19 · Switch tabs while AI works — and the keys
artboards.note: Leave mid-run; AI keeps going and tells you when it's done. Tabs move with ⌃Tab like every Mac app; ⌘0 and ⌘1 stay zoom.

artboards.label: 20 · After a restart — 20 tabs come back, resting
artboards.note: Proposed: after a restart, every tab comes back. Only the front one runs; the rest wake when you open them.

artboards.label: 21 · A link from Slack — right tab, right artboard
artboards.note: A link opens the exact spot. Its tab comes forward (or opens), the canvas glides to the story and her comment opens. The link is alligators.cloud.maude.sh/c/combine-kampan — a move or rename keeps it.

artboards.label: 22 · A project that moved · access removed · now Can view
artboards.note: Words, not errors — nothing thrown away. A moved folder is found again. Removed and Can view happen on Brno Open 2026, Tereza's project: changes were saved first; Ask to edit goes to her.
